test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SIGNAL' is coded as 'H18T13Z15', and 'TARGET' is coded as 'G26I20V7'. How will 'VOLUME' be coded in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic follows here is: 

According to the above table, **Alphabets opposite to given alphabet and their positional value opposite to given alphabet are used alternately.**

In SIGNAL →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69c9994310e4e3eb23dcd0b6080178631a0bc32f2ff2394f10dc42a2c4570ca9.png] 

And,

In TARGET →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b357b29cb60cc98ce148a9cd3afca92a8d29ed2e4fb857aeabf3d782a6ac8538.png] 

Similarly, 

In VOLUME →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18d071fdb826648bd31d930274455a89d322d922711ed75f9771f22d32e1ab1a.png] 

So, VOLUME will be coded as **E12O6N22**.

Hence, Option (2) is the answer.
